text:
[IRET.12.3] **Multiple justifiers.** A logical fact F
asserted by two activations A1 and A2 has
`justif_count = 2`. When A1 ends, `justif_count` drops
to 1; F is not retracted. When A2 also ends,
`justif_count` drops to 0 and F is retracted.

idris.name: iret_12_3__boundary_ranked
idris.note: ON ACYCLIC SUPPORT the live set at a boundary is exactly the well-founded set: recompute-and-diff would change nothing, as the refcount is exact there.

idris.name: iret_12_3__ante_bound
idris.note: An antecedent of a live row ranks no higher than the row's stratum: a dead id ranks zero, and a live one is a fact the row's rule read, whose every emitter is in a lower stratum.

idris.name: iret_12_3__certified_ranked
idris.note: THE KIND-LEVEL CERTIFICATE GIVES ACYCLIC SUPPORT: at every state between actions of a run of a positive program certified over the kind graph, the engine's table is ranked, so the refcount is exact there (`iret_12_3__ranked_agree`). `partial`: a program [LCYC.3.1.1] admits only through [LCYC.6.1]'s literal break has no such certificate.

idris.name: iret_12_3__level_down
idris.note: A bound on every emitter's stratum bounds the kind's level.

idris.name: iret_12_3__level_from
idris.note: A kind's level: one more than the highest stratum of a rule emitting it, zero for a kind no rule emits.

idris.name: iret_12_3__level_of
idris.note: What one rule contributes to a kind's level: one more than its stratum if it emits the kind.

idris.name: iret_12_3__level_of_bound
idris.note: A bound on an emitting rule's contribution bounds the rule's contribution.

idris.name: iret_12_3__level_of_emit
idris.note: An emitting rule contributes one more than its stratum.

idris.name: iret_12_3__level_up
idris.note: An emitter's stratum is below the kind's level.

idris.name: iret_12_3__max
idris.note: The larger of two naturals, by structure.

idris.name: iret_12_3__max_left
idris.note: It bounds its left argument.

idris.name: iret_12_3__max_lub
idris.note: And is the least such bound.

idris.name: iret_12_3__max_right
idris.note: And its right.

idris.name: iret_12_3__rank
idris.note: The rank of an id against a working memory.

idris.name: iret_12_3__rank_of
idris.note: A fact's rank: its kind's level; zero for an id no live fact carries.

idris.name: Iret_12_3__self_free
idris.note: No justification of a stratum reads a fact the stratum derives: what [LCYC.3.1.1] makes of every SCC it admits.

idris.name: iret_12_3__self_free_ranked
idris.note: A SELF-FREE STRATUM IS RANKED, so the refcount is exact on it -- why the hybrid may keep justif_count outside the recursive strata.

idris.name: iret_12_3__self_rank
idris.note: Rank one for a fact the stratum derives, zero otherwise.

idris.name: iret_12_3__self_rank_ante
idris.note: An antecedent of a self-free stratum ranks zero: it is no target.

idris.name: iret_12_3__self_rank_target
idris.note: A target ranks one.

idris.name: iret_12_3__targets
idris.note: A stratum's targets.

idris.name: Iret_12_3__ranked
idris.note: A ranking of the support graph (every antecedent strictly below its target), which a graph admits iff it is acyclic. The theorem it is for is `iret_12_3__ranked_exact`: under a ranking the cascade equals the well-founded set, of which tms_cascade.tla's `no_unsupported_forever` is an instance.

idris.name: iret_12_2__tla_retract_f1
idris.note: Executed: retracting f1 leaves f2 with one justifier and live, as the clause says; f3 stays with it.

idris.name: iret_12_3__ranked_agree
idris.note: The two fixpoints agree on every ranked instance, not only the one tms_cascade.tla draws.

idris.name: iret_12_3__ranked_exact
idris.note: Strong induction on rank: a survivor is a base fact or kept alive by a justification whose antecedents survive and rank lower, hence are well-founded, so the same justification derives it. The clause's multiple-justifier fact is the ranked case.

idris.name: iret_12_3__tla_js
idris.note: tms_cascade.tla's instance: f2 justified by {f1} and by {f4}, f3 by {f2} -- the clause's two-justifier fact.
